description: Electron-builder creates a combined NSIS installer when multiple Windows architectures are built, based on https://github.com/electron-userland/electron-builder/issues/8298.
prompt:
My Windows release now builds x64 and arm64, but the output includes a combined installer and that breaks our native module story. I only want separate installers per architecture.

```
• building target=nsis file=release/ScoutDesk Setup 2.4.0.exe archs=x64, arm64
• building target=nsis file=release/ScoutDesk Setup 2.4.0-arm64.exe archs=arm64
```
